name: ESOP / Exercise to Date Sync
description: 读取 Futu 员工行权记录源工作簿的行权汇总数据（中文『行权汇总数据』或 Cap Table 的英文 `Futu BCI Exercises to Date`），按「截至当月」合并进 Exercise Record 展示数据。

tasks.name: Extract Futu Exercise Summary

params.emptyColumns: 姓名, 工号, 牛牛号, 用户ID, 授予编号, 授予日期, 授予价(USD), 行权日期, 行权下单数量, 行权成功数量, 行权成本(USD), 扣除/卖出数量, 成交数量

tasks.description: 从 Futu 员工行权记录源工作簿提取行权表：『行权汇总数据』（中文 13 列）或 Cap Table 工作簿的『Futu BCI Exercises to Date』（英文 13 列），sheet 由上游传入。该输入为可选：未提供时输出空 dataframe，月度运行不会因此中断（记录页该月显示为空）。未提供文件时按 emptyColumns 输出空表，供下游合并使用。

tasks.name: Project Futu Exercise Summary

guards.name: Assert Futu Exercise Source Column Shape

params.failureMessage: Futu 行权源的列数应为 13：『行权汇总数据』或『Futu BCI Exercises to Date』；行权明细数据是 59 列

params.sql:
select
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([姓名], [Name], '') as string)), '') as [Name],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([工号], [Employee No.], '') as string)), '') as [Employee No.],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([牛牛号], [Futubull ID], '') as string)), '') as [Futubull ID],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([用户ID], [User ID], '') as string)), '') as [User ID],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([授予编号], [Grant No.], '') as string)), '') as [Grant No.],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([授予日期], [Grant Date], '') as string)), '') as [Grant Date],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([授予价(USD)], [Grant Price(USD)], '') as string)), '') as [Grant Price(USD)],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([行权日期], [Exercise Date], '') as string)), '') as [Exercise Date],
  case when cast(coalesce([行权下单数量], [Ordered Qty], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast(coalesce([行权下单数量], [Ordered Qty]) as number) end as [Ordered Qty],
  case when cast(coalesce([行权成功数量], [Exercised Qty], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast(coalesce([行权成功数量], [Exercised Qty]) as number) end as [Exercised Qty],
  case when cast(coalesce([行权成本(USD)], [Exercise Cost(USD)], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast(coalesce([行权成本(USD)], [Exercise Cost(USD)]) as number) end as [Exercise Cost(USD)],
  case when cast(coalesce([扣除/卖出数量], [Deduction/Selling Qty.], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast(coalesce([扣除/卖出数量], [Deduction/Selling Qty.]) as number) end as [Deduction/Selling Qty.],
  case when cast(coalesce([成交数量], [Dealt Qty.], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast(coalesce([成交数量], [Dealt Qty.]) as number) end as [Dealt Qty.]
from {exercises}
where coalesce(trim(cast(coalesce([工号], [Employee No.], '') as string)), '') <> ''
  and coalesce(trim(cast(coalesce([工号], [Employee No.], '') as string)), '') <> '工号'
  and coalesce(trim(cast(coalesce([工号], [Employee No.], '') as string)), '') <> 'Employee No.'
  and coalesce(trim(cast(coalesce([姓名], [Name], '') as string)), '') not in ('合计', 'in Total')

tasks.description: 把行权源（中文『行权汇总数据』或英文『Futu BCI Exercises to Date』，用 coalesce(中文列, 英文列) 同时吃下）映射为 Exercise Record 的 13 列标准契约，并丢弃合计/in Total 行与空工号行。

tasks.name: Extract exercise_futu base
tasks.description: 读取上一月的累计快照作为 base；未提供时输出空表，合并结果即当月增量。

params.emptyColumns: Name, Employee No., Futubull ID, User ID, Grant No., Grant Date, Grant Price(USD), Exercise Date, Ordered Qty, Exercised Qty, Exercise Cost(USD), Deduction/Selling Qty., Dealt Qty.

tasks.name: Merge exercise_futu records
tasks.description: 按 Employee No. + Grant No. + Exercise Date 幂等合并 base 与本月增量：同键以增量覆盖，base 独有的行保留（历史不丢）。

tasks.name: Cut The Snapshot At The Run Month
tasks.description: 把合并结果截断到运行月份（含）：行权记录页展示的是「截至当月的累计行权」，而富途导出的汇总 sheet 是滚动窗口（2026-06 那份就覆盖 2026-03~08），合并算子自己不带日期过滤，于是 6 月的页面会端出 8 月的行。日期为空的行照旧计入（与 calc_futu_metrics 的口径一致）。

tasks.name: Persist Futu BCI Exercises to Date File
tasks.description: 写出截至当月的累计快照（base + 本月增量幂等合并、再按运行月份截断），放在独立目录、文件名带月份后缀，既给页面按月读取，也作为下一月合并的 base。
